_doc: Round 2 (QA r1 finding 42). Per unit: exact find/replace pairs applied by ccg_common.tag_percents before the automatic same-jurisdiction percent tagging (fact notes and pack prose are generator inputs owned by agent 2, so the correction is applied here, at generation). A percentage that is a fact is tagged with its key; a percentage that is not a fact (prior-year figure, sum, statutory mechanism, other-tax figure) is reworded without the number. _exclude = contexts where a percentage equals a fact by coincidence and must not be auto-tagged. Also used for two non-percent text fixes of fact notes at generation (AL.14 oracle note, finding 63).

_exclude.why: youth minimum-wage step, not the minimum withholding rate
